description: This file defines the Notification controller class for the admin tool module of an OpenCart project. It manages listing, viewing, and deleting notifications via web requests, integrating with models, views, and language resources.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Controller class for managing admin notifications within the OpenCart admin tool module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main notifications page with header, footer, and list data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to retrieve the notification list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for a paginated list of notifications, including time ago calculations.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information for a specific notification and marks it as read.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected notifications if the user has appropriate permissions, returning success or error as JSON.
